features.name: On-device JavaScript runtime (JS Runner)
features.description: A built-in scripting engine allowing user-authored JavaScript to control device functions.
features.differentiation_value: high - distinctive capability, but high security-review burden

features.name: Dolphin gamification system (XP/levels) + Passport profile screen
features.description: Non-utilitarian usage-tracking/leveling system tied to app interactions.
features.differentiation_value: already inherited via Unleashed base - not a new differentiator for this project specifically

features.name: GPIO expansion-module protocol/service
features.description: Formal, versioned protocol for external GPIO accessory modules to identify themselves and communicate with firmware, distinct from raw GPIO pin access.
features.differentiation_value: foundational for RFC 4 (Hardware and Module Compatibility Hub)

features.name: CCID (smart-card USB) moved from firmware HAL to optional FAP
features.description: A real, recent (per this phase's census retrieval) upstream change relocating CCID USB support out of firmware core into a debug FAP specifically to reclaim ~1.7KB of flash, alongside an API version bump from 87.3 to 88.0 (breaking).
features.differentiation_value: n/a - this is a real upstream engineering data point, not a feature to import; recorded as a concrete precedent for this project's own external-FAP-by-default resource discipline (see MODULAR_FIRMWARE_PROFILES.md)

features.name: Native MIFARE Plus SL3 support (AES auth, dictionary attack, full SL3 emulation)
features.source_path: (firmware-level NFC stack extension, not a single app path)
features.description: Extended NFC card protocol support beyond official firmware.
features.differentiation_value: n/a for this project - NFC emulation/attack features are explicitly out of this project's automation and forbidden-test scope

features.name: "Dangerous Settings" extended/unlocked Sub-GHz frequency range
features.description: A firmware setting that unlocks Sub-GHz transmission outside default-regulated frequency ranges.
features.differentiation_value: n/a for this project - directly conflicts with this project's Sub-GHz transmission prohibition

features.name: Custom unified Settings app replacing stock OFW settings
features.description: A consolidated, redesigned settings experience replacing the stock per-service settings apps.
features.differentiation_value: moderate - directly relevant prior art for RFC 3 (Unified Search) and general UX differentiation, but a large, invasive change to port

features.name: Asset Packs theming engine (custom animations/icons/fonts)
features.description: A file-format-based system letting users install custom animation/icon/font packs without a firmware rebuild.
features.differentiation_value: high - low-risk, cosmetic-only, genuinely differentiating, and philosophically aligned with this project's Smart App Packs (RFC 2) design

features.name: Extended Sub-GHz frequency ranges + GPS-tagged "Subdriving" capture
features.source_path: (firmware-level Sub-GHz extension, not a single app path)
features.description: Extended Sub-GHz capability with location-tagged signal capture.
features.differentiation_value: n/a for this project - Sub-GHz transmission/capture is explicitly out of this project's automation and forbidden-test scope

features.name: Disk-image mounting / virtual mass storage
features.source_path: (firmware-level storage extension, not a single app path)
features.description: Allows the device to present a mounted disk image as USB mass storage.
features.differentiation_value: moderate - a genuinely useful capability, but storage/USB-mode changes need careful safety review given this project's non-destructive-storage discipline
